'''GBX-005''' was a contract signed between [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] [[Guther Bartyn]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and [[Ubrikkian Private Shipwrights]], a division of [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. Ubrikkian would provide Bartyn with an aquatic speeder yacht, later known as ''[[Tria Blue]]'', in exchange for some money.
